name: print-social-pink-flat-lay-plans-post-with-chat-bubble
title: Cream post with a pink chat bubble excuse, big pink 'MY PLANS:' and a scattered flat lay of pink self-care objects
whatItIs: A cream portrait with a pink message bubble ('Sorry, I can't meet today. I already have plans...'), a giant pink extended 'МОЇ ПЛАНИ:' and a scatter of cutout pink and white objects: candle bowl, hair claws, scrunchie, jade roller, pyjamas, slippers, journal and perfume, with a handle at the bottom.
whatItMeans: Cosy and witty; a texted excuse is answered by a pile of comforting objects.
techniques: Open with a chat bubble as setup.
Scatter cutout objects in one colour family.
Use a bold pink headline on cream.
Keep the layout loose and airy.

vocabulary.definition: A message bubble that frames the joke.
Objects with backgrounds removed arranged loosely.
Objects in shades of one hue.
A layout with generous space between elements.
